title: Recorded chart transport equals generic derived chart coefficient map
statement: For arbitrary composable scheme morphisms, the recorded ordinary finite chart transport equals the canonical derived chart coefficient map.

source.place: Identification of the four factors in the selected projection chart transport

proof.text: Compare the two chart-transport constructions by structural heterogeneous congruence. Unfold only the recorded pullback, pushforward, adjunction and chart-map aliases, and the generic chart coefficient composite. The resulting terms have the same adjunction-unit, composition-comparison, equality-comparison and direct-image factors. Match their arguments recursively, using proof irrelevance for proposition-valued instance arguments and kernel-checked congruence for applications. Keep derived localization and derived-functor constructions folded. Convert the resulting heterogeneous equality to equality.

lean.statement:
theorem ordinaryFiniteChartTransport_eq_derivedChartCoefficientMap
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (e : X ⟶ Y) (p : Y ⟶ Z) (r : X ⟶ Z) (hr : e ≫ p = r)
    (L : DerivedCategoryModule A Y) (L' : DerivedCategoryModule A X)
    (v : (ordinaryFinitePullback A e).obj L ⟶ L') :
    ordinaryFiniteChartTransport A e p r hr L L' v =
      derivedChartCoefficientMap (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) e p r hr L L' v
